info.title: FeraEmail API
info.summary: Complete contract for SMTP profiles, email templates, delivery, shared signing owner, and lifecycle
info.description: Source-traced FeraEmail contract reconciled to actual mounts: 17 behaviors, 16 aliases, and 33 callable operations. It documents write-only credentials, raw/template send modes, attachments, opt-out rendering, SMTP acceptance, permissions, shared FeraSign profile provisioning, and lifecycle HMAC.

EmailError.x-additionalProperties-reason: Controllers preserve safe SMTP, template-build, lifecycle, validation, and provisioning error fields.

owner.description: Owner UUID; defaults to authenticated instance.

port.description: SMTP port; 465/2465 use secure transport and 25/587/2587 require TLS.

password.description: SMTP password accepted on write and never returned.

EmailTemplate.x-additionalProperties-reason: The template serializer preserves owner-scoped category, HTML, metadata, and audit fields.

meta.x-additionalProperties-reason: Template metadata is namespaced by email-producing product features.

Attachment.x-additionalProperties-reason: Nodemailer attachment options include provider-supported content, encoding, path, headers, and stream fields; response projection exposes only filename and cid.

content.description: Inline attachment content, commonly base64 with an encoding option.

path.description: Authorized service-local or provider URL source accepted by Nodemailer.

configuration.description: SMTP profile name; falls back to name for legacy template sends.

name.description: Template name; omit for raw email mode.

owner.description: Owner UUID; defaults to authenticated instance.

xml.description: XML data used to build the selected template.

recipient.description: Template-mode recipient or raw-mode alias for to.

from.description: Raw-mode sender; falls back to latest owner template sender.

unsubscribeUrl.description: Optional campaign opt-out URL appended once to rendered HTML.

attachments.description: Nodemailer attachments passed to transport; use trusted content sources only.

SendResult.x-additionalProperties-reason: SMTP transport info is provider-owned; rendered fields are stable safe previews and exclude attachment content/passwords.

success.description: Whether build and SMTP send completed.

info.x-additionalProperties-reason: Nodemailer transport result varies by SMTP provider.

rendered.x-additionalProperties-reason: Rendered raw/template fields vary by send mode while attachment projection is deliberately safe.
rendered.description: Final sender, recipients, subject, body, and safe attachment names/cids.

EmailResult.x-additionalProperties-reason: Configuration, template, lifecycle, and shared-owner operations return their documented family-specific serializer fields.

data.x-additionalProperties-reason: Imported template data preserves safe source template fields and parent UUID.

LifecycleEvent.x-additionalProperties-reason: FeraLicense lifecycle payload includes event-specific plan, settings, and correlation fields.

data.x-additionalProperties-reason: Lifecycle data is owned by FeraLicense and selected by eventType.

LifecycleAcknowledgment.x-additionalProperties-reason: Lifecycle success and failure result fields differ by provisioning, settings, and deprovisioning family.
